---
title: "All Insider Transactions in One Table"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output: html_document
params:
  data_dir: "insider_data"       # folder for storing SEC-reported insider data
  from: ""                       # leave 'from' and 'to' blank to include all data
  to: ""                         # 
  include_derivative: true       # include derivative transactions
  save_to: "insider_all.rds"     # save the data.table as an .rds file
---

<!--
Builds ONE data.table, `insider`, from everything 01_insider_pipeline.Rmd has stored:
one row per reported transaction (Forms 3/4/5 and amendments) with filing, issuer and
reporting-owner info on every row.

HOW TO USE
  * Knit it: the result is saved to save_to (default insider_all.rds). Load it anywhere with
      insider <- readRDS("insider_all.rds")
    (Knitting runs in a separate R session, so the table itself doesn't stay in your environment.)
  * Or open it in RStudio and use Run All: `insider` is then in your environment directly.

NOTES
  * ISSUERCIK and RPTOWNERCIK are integers.
  * A filing can have several reporting owners (e.g. an executive and their trust). To keep one row
    per transaction, RPTOWNERCIK / RPTOWNERNAME / RPTOWNER_TITLE are the first-listed owner; IS_* flags
    are 1 if ANY owner has that role; N_OWNERS counts them; ALL_OWNER_CIKS lists all owner CIKs when
    there is more than one.
  * DERIVATIVE = 0 for stock transactions, 1 for options/RSUs/warrants etc.
  * Amendments (DOCUMENT_TYPE "4/A" etc.) are included; filter them out if you only want originals.
  * Holdings-only rows and footnote text are not transactions and are not included.
  * The full 2006-present history is large (tens of millions of rows, several GB of RAM).
    Set `from` to limit it, e.g. from: "2009-01-01".
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
if (!requireNamespace("R.utils", quietly = TRUE)) stop("install.packages('R.utils') is needed to read .csv.gz files")
```

```{r config}
DATA_DIR           <- params$data_dir
FROM               <- if (nzchar(params$from)) params$from else NULL
TO                 <- if (nzchar(params$to)) params$to else NULL
INCLUDE_DERIVATIVE <- isTRUE(params$include_derivative)
SAVE_TO            <- if (nzchar(params$save_to)) params$save_to else NULL
if (!dir.exists(file.path(DATA_DIR, "tables"))) stop("No data found at ", normalizePath(DATA_DIR, mustWork = FALSE),
                                                     ". Run 01_insider_pipeline.Rmd first, or set data_dir.")
t0 <- Sys.time()
```

```{r read-helper}
# read one table, only the needed quarter files and columns
.read <- function(tbl, cols) {
  files <- list.files(file.path(DATA_DIR, "tables", tbl), pattern = "\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(files)) stop("No files found for '", tbl, "' in ", DATA_DIR, ". Has 01_insider_pipeline.Rmd been run?")
  tags <- sub("^(sec|xml)_", "", sub("\\.csv\\.gz$", "", basename(files)))
  qs <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(sprintf("%s-%02d-01", substr(tags, 1, 4), (as.integer(substr(tags, 6, 6)) - 1) * 3 + 1), format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
  keep <- is.na(qs)
  lo <- if (is.null(FROM)) as.Date("1900-01-01") else as.Date(FROM) - 185   # late filings can sit a quarter back
  hi <- if (is.null(TO)) as.Date("2999-12-31") else as.Date(TO)
  files <- files[keep | (!is.na(qs) & qs >= lo & qs <= hi)]
  rbindlist(lapply(files, fread, select = cols, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "",
                   encoding = "UTF-8", showProgress = FALSE), fill = TRUE)
}
.int <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
.date <- function(x) as.IDate(x, format = "%Y-%m-%d")   # explicit format: safe even if a column is all missing
.num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
```

```{r filings}
# filings
sub <- .read("submission", c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "FILING_DATE", "DOCUMENT_TYPE", "PERIOD_OF_REPORT",
                             "ISSUERCIK", "ISSUERNAME", "ISSUERTRADINGSYMBOL", "AFF10B5ONE"))
sub[, `:=`(FILING_DATE = .date(FILING_DATE), PERIOD_OF_REPORT = .date(PERIOD_OF_REPORT),
           ISSUERCIK = .int(ISSUERCIK), AFF10B5ONE = .int(AFF10B5ONE))]
if (!is.null(FROM)) sub <- sub[FILING_DATE >= as.IDate(FROM)]
if (!is.null(TO))   sub <- sub[FILING_DATE <= as.IDate(TO)]
sub <- unique(sub, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER")
```

```{r owners}
# reporting owners, collapsed to one row per filing
own <- .read("reportingowner", c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "RPTOWNERCIK", "RPTOWNERNAME", "RPTOWNER_TITLE",
                                 "IS_DIRECTOR", "IS_OFFICER", "IS_TENPERCENTOWNER", "IS_OTHER"))
own <- own[ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% sub$ACCESSION_NUMBER]
flags <- c("IS_DIRECTOR", "IS_OFFICER", "IS_TENPERCENTOWNER", "IS_OTHER")
for (f in flags) set(own, j = f, value = fcoalesce(.int(own[[f]]), 0L))
own_flags <- own[, c(lapply(.SD, max), list(N_OWNERS = .N)), by = ACCESSION_NUMBER, .SDcols = flags]
own_first <- unique(own, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER")[, .(ACCESSION_NUMBER, RPTOWNERCIK = .int(RPTOWNERCIK),
                                                      RPTOWNERNAME, RPTOWNER_TITLE)]
multi <- own_flags[N_OWNERS > 1, ACCESSION_NUMBER]
own_all <- own[ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% multi, .(ALL_OWNER_CIKS = paste(RPTOWNERCIK, collapse = ";")), by = ACCESSION_NUMBER]
owners <- merge(merge(own_first, own_flags, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER"), own_all, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER", all.x = TRUE)
rm(own, own_flags, own_first, own_all)
```

```{r transactions}
# transactions
tcols <- c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "SECURITY_TITLE", "TRANS_DATE", "DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE", "TRANS_FORM_TYPE",
           "TRANS_CODE", "EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED", "TRANS_TIMELINESS", "TRANS_SHARES", "TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE",
           "TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP", "NATURE_OF_OWNERSHIP")
nd <- .read("nonderiv_trans", c(tcols, "NONDERIV_TRANS_SK"))
setnames(nd, "NONDERIV_TRANS_SK", "TRANS_SK")
nd[, DERIVATIVE := 0L]
tr <- list(nd)
if (INCLUDE_DERIVATIVE) {
  dv <- .read("deriv_trans", c(tcols, "DERIV_TRANS_SK", "TRANS_TOTAL_VALUE", "CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE",
                               "EXCERCISE_DATE", "EXPIRATION_DATE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_TITLE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_SHARES"))
  setnames(dv, c("DERIV_TRANS_SK", "EXCERCISE_DATE"), c("TRANS_SK", "EXERCISE_DATE"))  # SEC misspells it
  dv[, DERIVATIVE := 1L]
  tr[[2]] <- dv
}
tr <- rbindlist(tr, fill = TRUE)
rm(nd); if (INCLUDE_DERIVATIVE) rm(dv)
tr <- tr[ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% sub$ACCESSION_NUMBER]

for (c in intersect(c("TRANS_DATE", "DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE", "EXERCISE_DATE", "EXPIRATION_DATE"), names(tr)))
  set(tr, j = c, value = .date(tr[[c]]))
for (c in intersect(c("TRANS_SHARES", "TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "TRANS_TOTAL_VALUE",
                      "CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_SHARES", "TRANS_SK"), names(tr)))
  set(tr, j = c, value = .num(tr[[c]]))
tr[, EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED := .int(EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED)]
tr[, TRANS_VALUE := TRANS_SHARES * TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE]
```

```{r combine}
# one dataframe
insider <- merge(sub, owners, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER", all.x = TRUE)[tr, on = "ACCESSION_NUMBER", nomatch = NULL]
rm(sub, owners, tr); invisible(gc())

front <- c("FILING_DATE", "ACCESSION_NUMBER", "DOCUMENT_TYPE", "ISSUERCIK", "ISSUERNAME", "ISSUERTRADINGSYMBOL",
           "RPTOWNERCIK", "RPTOWNERNAME", "RPTOWNER_TITLE", flags, "N_OWNERS", "ALL_OWNER_CIKS",
           "DERIVATIVE", "TRANS_SK", "TRANS_DATE", "TRANS_CODE", "TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD", "TRANS_SHARES",
           "TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "TRANS_VALUE", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP")
setcolorder(insider, intersect(front, names(insider)))
setorderv(insider, c("FILING_DATE", "ACCESSION_NUMBER", "DERIVATIVE", "TRANS_SK"))

if (!is.null(SAVE_TO)) saveRDS(insider, SAVE_TO)

say <- function(...) cat(paste0(...), "\n", sep = "")
show <- function(x, caption = NULL, ...) {          # plain console-style table
  if (!is.null(caption)) cat(caption, "\n", sep = "")
  print(as.data.table(x), nrows = 1e5, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}
say(sprintf("insider: %s transactions from %s filings, %s to %s | %.1f GB in memory | built in %.1f min",
            format(nrow(insider), big.mark = ","), format(uniqueN(insider$ACCESSION_NUMBER), big.mark = ","),
            min(insider$FILING_DATE), max(insider$FILING_DATE),
            as.numeric(object.size(insider)) / 1e9, as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
yr <- insider[, .(Transactions = .N, Filings = uniqueN(ACCESSION_NUMBER),
                  `Open-market buys (P)` = sum(TRANS_CODE == "P", na.rm = TRUE),
                  `Open-market sales (S)` = sum(TRANS_CODE == "S", na.rm = TRUE)),
              by = .(Year = as.character(year(FILING_DATE)))][order(Year)]
show(yr)
say("")
if (!is.null(SAVE_TO)) say("Saved to ", normalizePath(SAVE_TO), ". Load with: insider <- readRDS(\"", SAVE_TO, "\")")
```
